title: Te Kaitiaki i te Tapa o te Awa
intro: I tētahi whenua i puta ai te pouri ki ngā kāinga maha i te ture a te kaitukino, i tae mai he karere ki tētahi wairua i whakahē i ngā wehi katoa. Me te ngākau kī tonu i te whakawhirinaki, ka tīmata rātou i tētahi mahi whakapono ka huri i te huarahi o tētahi iwi. I te mea e kawe ana ngā wai i tētahi utanga utu nui, ka hanumi te tumanako ki ngā ia.
clues: I noho ahau i te wā o te tukino me te wehi.
Ua farii au i te faaururaa no te ra‘i tei horo‘a mai i te maia ia‘u.
I whakahaua ahau kia kaua e wehi, kia kaua hoki e pouri.
I whakatakotoria e au taku tamaiti ki roto i te pouaka, ā, i whakatakotoria ki runga i te wai.
I kitea taku tamaiti e te whare o te rangatira, engari i aru mai taku tamaiti tuarua.
I tūtaki anō māua ko taku tamaiti ki te whāngai i a ia, pērā i tā te Atua i oati ai.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
